concerns.title: Wrapped memory exhaustion can receive the wrong failure status

evidence.detail: Classification examines the outer exception type and exact CUDA OOM phrase only.
Geometry operations wrap MemoryError/OutOfMemoryError in PairedGeometryError with an exception cause.

concerns.reproduction: The actual extracted sealed PairedGeometryError wrapping MemoryError('mock host memory exhaustion') yields qualification_failed; the same type with CUDA out of memory text yields resource_deferred. Mock receipts are retained in REVIEW_CHECKS.json.
concerns.impact: Genuine wrapped memory exhaustion is misclassified as source qualification failure despite the promised resource-deferred status. Geometry error details are retained and scientific_merit_assessed stays false.
concerns.requested_correction: Inspect exception cause/context chains and retained geometry error types for memory exhaustion; preserve explicit resource deferral and existing error receipts. Add wrapped host/GPU OOM stdlib mocks in a separately sealed version.

concerns.title: Topology receipt retains a permutation hash rather than the permutation vector

evidence.detail: The receipt saves seed and hash plus equality assertions, but not the actual vector.
The paired caller contract asks for a saved permutation and topology equality receipt.

concerns.impact: The vector remains reconstructible from the frozen source/runtime/seed, but its retention is indirect.
concerns.suggested_correction: Persist the unlabeled permutation vector in the new run receipt to directly satisfy the caller's saved-permutation instruction.
